newsitem.title: USA: Hartford Steam sees lower Q3 EPS.
newsitem.headline: Hartford Steam sees lower Q3 EPS.

text.p: The Hartford Steam Boiler Inspection and Insurance Co said Monday it expects third quarter earnings to be 25 to 30 cents lower than earlier projections, primarily due to insurance losses from recent hurricanes and storms, including flooding, and lower than expected income from Radian International Llc.
Wall Street had estimated the company would earn about $0.80 per share for the third quarter, Vice President James Rowan said in a telephone interview.
The company earned $0.80 per share in the third quarter of 1995.

The reduction in expected earnings includes storm damages from Hurricane Fran, which Rowan said appears to be one of the five most costly hurricanes to impact the United States in terms of insured damage.
Radian International LLC, formed in January, is Hartford Steam Boiler's joint venture with The Dow Chemical Co, with Dow owning 60 percent and Hartford Steam Boiler 40 percent.
The new company's revenues from environmental services for commercial and Department of Energy customers are running below projected levels in the United States, Rowan said.
